View.Text: Earth: Oh, Moon-chan! I didn't see you orbiting me!
View.ColorText: Earth: Oh, <color=yellow> Moon-chan! </color> I didn't see you orbiting me!

View.Text: Moon: Sh-shut up, dumbass! I was just passing by, okay!?
Earth: Oh no... I'm gonna be late for class!
Earth: We'll have to catch up later, Moon-chan!
View.ColorText: Earth: We'll have to catch up later, <color=yellow>Moon-chan!</color>

View.Text: Moon: Hey, Earth-senpai! Wait just a minute!
Earth: Huh? Was something the matter?
(Damnit Moon... just tell him how you feel already!)
Moon: Y-you're always forgetting your lunch, senpai...
View.ColorText: Moon: Y-you're <color=red>always forgetting your lunch,</color> senpai...

View.Text: Moon: T-t-today, I packed a lunch for you...!!
View.ColorText: Moon: T-t-today, I packed a <color=green>lunch</color> for you...!!

View.Text: Earth: M-Moon-chan! Does... does this mean what I think it-
View.ColorText: Earth: <color=yellow>M-Moon-chan!</color> Does... does this mean what I think it-

View.Text: Moon: What!? N-no! Of course not! Get those weird thoughts out of your head!
Earth: ...I see... well! Thank you for the meal, Moon-chan!
View.ColorText: Earth: ...I see... well! Thank you for the meal, <color=yellow>Moon-chan!</color>

View.Text: Moon: Oh senpai... I wanted you to notice...
Moon: ...I really WAS orbiting you on purpose...
